summary: ClipForge Mobile: a cross-platform (iOS/Android) offline-first native-feeling video & photo editing SaaS-style mobile app inspired by CapCut, with optional cloud sync and optional Pro monetization, featuring templates and a dynamic OTA/remote-config update system.
architectural_notes: Cross-platform mobile app: choose React Native (Expo) or Flutter; must feel native, smooth, and high-performance.
Offline-first architecture with local persistence (SQLite/AsyncStorage) for projects/assets/templates.
Use FFmpeg mobile bindings for local media processing and Skia/native rendering for editor canvas UI.
OTA updates via Expo Updates or CodePush; remote JSON configuration for feature toggles and template/tool enablement.
Remote template repository with download-and-cache for offline availability; silent background updates with major-update prompt.
Optional cloud sync layer (Firebase or Supabase).
Optional Pro monetization via feature gating + Stripe or in-app purchase integration.

existing_features.title: Implement a mobile-first, app-like web UI (PWA-style) for “ClipForge Mobile” that runs smoothly on mobile browsers (iOS Safari/Android Chrome) with bottom navigation tabs: Home, Templates, Create, Projects, Profile; include dark mode and light mode.

Create a cohesive “CapCut-inspired” editing UI/UX theme (without copying branding) with a clean modern SaaS look: typography, spacing system, component styles, motion/transition guidelines, and consistent use across the app (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).

Implement an offline-first local data layer for projects, imported media metadata, and downloaded templates with instant loading on repeat visits (use browser storage such as IndexedDB/localStorage as appropriate).

Build a Templates section with preloaded editable template catalog entries for: Video (TikTok intro, YouTube intro, Slideshow, Birthday video, Business promo) and Photo (Instagram post, YouTube thumbnail, Poster, Resume cover, Flyer). Each template must be editable and downloadable/cached for offline use.

Implement a video editor experience (offline-capable) with a timeline-based UI supporting multi-layer composition (video, audio, text, stickers) and essential operations: trim, split, crop, transitions, text animations, music library selection, speed control, filters/color adjustments, and export options for 720p and 1080p with no watermark.

Implement a photo editor experience (offline-capable) supporting crop/resize, filters/presets, brightness/contrast/saturation controls, adding text and stickers, background blur, a basic background removal option, and export to JPG/PNG.

Implement a dynamic update architecture using a remotely configurable JSON document for: feature toggles, enabling/disabling tools, adding/removing templates, and a remote template repository with download + cache. Include version check on app launch, silent background refresh of config, and a user prompt when a major version change is detected.
Add Projects management: list, search/sort, duplicate, delete, and open projects (video/photo/template-derived). Store project metadata and editor state locally for offline use.

Add a feature-gating system that supports Free vs Pro entitlements as an optional toggle: Pro gates premium templates, advanced transitions, and advanced color grading controls; include UI indicators/upsell entry points but keep the app functional on Free.

Provide an app architecture deliverable inside the repo (documentation) describing: folder structure, state management approach, offline storage strategy, editor engine approach, and the dynamic update system flow (startup/version check/background refresh).
Generate and include required static brand/UI assets (icon, splash/hero, and empty-state illustrations) and render them from the frontend as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated.

new_feature_requests.summary: Set up cross-platform mobile app foundation (React Native Expo or Flutter) with smooth, high-performance UI and bottom navigation (Home, Templates, Create, Projects, Profile) plus dark/light mode.
Implement offline-first local data layer (SQLite/AsyncStorage) for projects, assets, templates cache, and instant loading.

Build offline video editor: timeline-based, multi-layer (video/audio/text/stickers), trim/split/crop, transitions, text animations, music library, speed control, filters/color grading, export 720p/1080p, no watermark.
Build offline photo editor: crop/resize, filters/presets, brightness/contrast/saturation, text/stickers, blur background, basic on-device background removal, export JPG/PNG.
Add editable templates section with preloaded free templates (video + photo) that download once, are stored locally, available offline, and load instantly.

Implement dynamic update architecture: OTA updates + remote JSON config for feature toggles/tools/templates, remote template repository (download & cache), version check on launch, silent background updates, and major-update prompt.
Optional cloud sync integration (Firebase or Supabase) to sync projects/assets across devices.
Optional SaaS monetization toggle: Free vs Pro plan with premium templates/advanced transitions/advanced color grading, feature gating, and Stripe or in-app purchases.
Editor rendering/engine setup using FFmpeg mobile bindings for processing and Skia/native rendering for canvas and gesture-based editing (e.g., pinch-to-zoom timeline).
Produce deliverables: full app architecture, folder structure, state management approach, OTA update setup, and store-ready build configuration for App Store/Play Store.

Backend: implement Motoko canister APIs for (a) remote config/versioning, (b) template catalog metadata, and (c) optional user-scoped cloud sync scaffolding that can be turned off by config (no third-party auth; use Internet Identity if authentication is needed).
